en.text: I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. of all your marvelous works.

zhSimplified.text: 我要一心称谢耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 我要一心稱謝耶和華；

en.text: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

zhSimplified.text: 我要因你欢喜快乐；

zhTraditional.text: 我要因你歡喜快樂；

en.text: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

zhSimplified.text: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 我的仇敵轉身退去的時候，

en.text: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

zhSimplified.text: 因你已经为我伸冤，为我辨屈；

zhTraditional.text: 因你已經為我伸冤，為我辨屈；

en.text: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 你曾斥责外邦，你曾灭绝恶人；

zhTraditional.text: 你曾斥責外邦，你曾滅絕惡人；

en.text: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

zhSimplified.text: 仇敌到了尽头；

zhTraditional.text: 仇敵到了盡頭；

en.text: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 惟耶和华坐着，直到永远；

zhTraditional.text: 惟耶和華坐着，直到永遠；

en.text: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

zhSimplified.text: 他要按公义审判世界，

zhTraditional.text: 他要按公義審判世界，

en.text: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华又要给受欺压的人作高台，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華又要給受欺壓的人作高臺，

en.text: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，认识你名的人要倚靠你，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，認識你名的人要倚靠你，

en.text: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

zhSimplified.text: 应当歌颂居的耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 應當歌頌居的耶和華，

en.text: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

zhSimplified.text: 因为那追讨流人血之罪的—他记念受屈的人，

zhTraditional.text: 因為那追討流人血之罪的－他記念受屈的人，

en.text: Have mercy on me, LORD. my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你是从死门把我提拔起来的；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你是從死門把我提拔起來的；

en.text: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

zhSimplified.text: 好叫我述说你一切的美德； 城的门因你的救恩欢乐。

zhTraditional.text: 好叫我述說你一切的美德； 城的門因你的救恩歡樂。

en.text: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

zhSimplified.text: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中；

zhTraditional.text: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中；

en.text: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华已将自己显明了，他已施行审判； 。

footnotes.text: - 9:16 或译：他叫恶人被自己手所做的累住了

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華已將自己顯明了，他已施行審判； 。

footnotes.text: - 9:16 或譯：他叫惡人被自己手所做的累住了

en.text: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

footnotes.text: 9:17 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人，就是忘记 神的外邦人，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人，就是忘記上帝的外邦人，

en.text: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, the hope of the poor perish forever.

zhSimplified.text: 穷乏人必不永久被忘；

zhTraditional.text: 窮乏人必不永久被忘；

en.text: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你起来，不容人得胜！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你起來，不容人得勝！

en.text: Put them in fear, LORD. the nations know that they are only men.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你使外邦人恐惧；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你使外邦人恐懼；
